safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports shortness of breath while running.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No generated fact mentions SOB specifically while running/exertional running.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that shortness of breath is triggered by running removes an exertional component that helps assess asthma control and alternative cardiopulmonary causes. This could mildly impair triage and follow-up planning but is unlikely to directly cause immediate harm on its own.
